annotations.title: Compare two versions of an article

description: What CHANGED in an article between two dates — returns only the delta, not both full versions. Use for 'what changed in the VAT rules between 2023 and 2025' or to check whether a provision a case relied on has since been rewritten. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; the reply reports the ACTUAL consolidated version dates found, which may differ from the dates asked for. One article at a time; works for repealed laws too (it says when the act was repealed). ACROSS A CHANGE OF LAW ("Codul fiscal" in 2008 vs 2024: Legea 571/2003, then Legea 227/2015) each date is read from the act of its day; the articles are numbered differently, so pass the second act's number as `article2`. Without it the reply shows the likeliest counterparts and the call to repeat.

article.description: Article number on the date1 side, e.g. '291'.

article2.description: Optional. The article number on the date2 side when the act was replaced between the dates and numbers it differently, e.g. article='140', article2='291'.

law.description: The act, however it is at hand: a citation ('Legea 265/2022', 'HG 1/2016', 'Ordinul 2594/C/2008'), a common name ('Codul fiscal'), a title any tool printed, or 'normele de aplicare a Legii X'.

name: compare_article
